notes: All 13 lordships, 26 facilities, 26 dungeon entrances, all 108 interior zones and 37 public faction markers are covered.
37 public faction locations may overlap existing buildings: reuse same background when same physical site; do not double-create images.
Exact facility and dungeon point coordinates not canonized; region IDs are anchors only.
Secrets in GM-only lore excluded from public asset catalog.
Priority P1 for basic location travel; P2 for all interiors and faction locations; P3 for shared generic scenes.
